name: Shokusou Tenshi Serika
source:
A mysterious parasite, verminion, comes from another planet and Serika is parasitized by it. However, she transforms into a female knight using its power and fights against it every day and night. As time passes, her body and heart gradually get weak.... However, she still fights to protect people....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302110706/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011549]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
神秘寄生生物从外星来到地球，寄生了真白芹香。然而，芹香反而借助它的力量化身女骑士，日夜与这些寄生生物战斗。随着时间流逝，她的身心逐渐衰弱……即便如此，她仍为保护人们而战……

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302110706/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011549]Eroge Shop[/url]]
